name: B10-0157/2026 (The Left) – Human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on reports that Russia recruits foreign nationals, especially Africans, with false job offers and then sends them to fight in Ukraine or work in weapons factories. It condemns these practices as human trafficking and forced labour, calls for the war to end, and asks EU countries to protect and help the victims and their families.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament only states its position and calls for action.
- **Who it affects:** Foreign recruits, mainly Africans, lured to Russia, and their families.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions, member states and Russia; no binding steps are set.
